title: A point of the target of a quasi-compact morphism reached by the image lies in the scheme theoretic image
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks a point of the target which is reached by the image of the morphism belongs to its scheme theoretic image (author lemma at source lines 2100-2113, label lemma-reach-points-scheme-theoretic-image). The proof (source lines 2115-2151) reformulates reachedness as a specialization condition, reduces to the corresponding statement for schemes along a smooth presentation of the target using the compatibility of the scheme theoretic image with flat base change, and returns to the stack (proof lines 2115-2150). The reformulation and the reduction are the substance. H3.
